description: Transaction receipt on Celo (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in CELO, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use celo_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xc6a38b860427aa5bd7f65f8a879a7d369e77b3767200c68cde4002014ad50444. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: celo_receipt
title: Celo transaction receipt
